{{ModBox}}
{{M|Accelerated Blast}} is a [[mod]] that increases the {{Stat|Fire Rate}} of [[:Category:Shotgun|shotguns]] by 15% and {{D|Puncture}} damage by 15% per rank for a maximum of 60% at max rank for both values.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! {{Stat|Fire Rate}}
! {{D|Puncture}} Damage
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +15% || +15% || 6
|-
| 1 || +30% || +30% || 7
|-
| 2 || +45% || +45% || 8
|-
| 3 || +60% || +60% || 9
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
* Can be paired with {{M|Shotgun Barrage}} and {{M|Frail Momentum}} to provide a 240% increase in {{Stat|Fire Rate}}.
* Stacks with {{M|Breach Loader}} and {{M|Flechette}} for a maximum of 270% {{D|Puncture}} damage.
* There are only five shotguns that deal primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage; the {{Weapon|Hek}}, {{Weapon|Vaykor Hek}}, {{Weapon|Corinth}}, {{Weapon|Corinth Prime}}, and {{Weapon|Cedo}}. All other shotguns, including the {{Weapon|Sweeper}} for [[Sentinel]]s, deal less than 20% of their base damage as Puncture.
*The {{Weapon|Phage}} deals no physical damage whatsoever, so it only benefits from the increase in {{Stat|Fire Rate}}.

==Trivia==
*Prior to {{ver|12.4}}, at base level the mod was increasing {{D|Puncture}} damage by 22% rather than 15% and adding the Puncture damage based on the weapon's total base damage, causing unusually large boosts in Puncture damage as a result. These bugs have since been fixed.
*The mod picture is misleading, as it implies that it adds [[punch through]] in order to puncture the [[Shield Lancer]]'s shield, when in reality it increases the puncture damage type. while also, the shotgun featured in the image is a {{W|Sobek}}. which deals mostly {{D|Impact}} damage.

*Extra puncture damage reduced from 22% per level to 15% per level.

{{ver|9}}

{{ModBox}}
{{M|Acid Shells}} is a [[Weapon Augments|Weapon Augment Mod]] exclusive to the {{Weapon|Sobek}} and {{Weapon|Kuva Sobek}} that causes enemies killed by the Sobek to explode, dealing a flat amount of {{D|Corrosive}} damage, plus a percentage of the enemy's maximum [[Health]] as {{D|Blast}} damage, to all enemies within 15m of the target.

== Stats ==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Flat Damage
! Percentage of Max Health
! Radius
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || 75 || 7.5% || 2.5m || 4
|-
| 1 || 150 || 15% || 5m || 5
|-
| 2 || 225 || 22.5% || 7.5m || 6
|-
| 3 || 300 || 30% || 10m || 7
|-
| 4 || 375 || 37.5% || 12.5m || 8
|-
| 5 || 450 || 45% || 15m || 9
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*The explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 0% from the central enemy.
*The explosion only hits enemies within [[Line of Sight]] of the central enemy.
*The explosion cannot apply a {{D|Corrosive}} or {{D|Blast}} status effect, and it cannot crit, even with [[Universal Weapon Bonuses]] that apply flat bonus crit chance.
*If the explosion caused by {{M|Acid Shells}} kills a nearby enemy, that enemy will also explode, creating a chain reaction that can lead to very large areas being cleared from a single shot.
*The Blast damage bonus does not account for the bonus Health given to enemies in [[The Steel Path]], [[Archon Hunt]], [[Deep Archimedea]], and similar modes.
*The corpses of enemies killed by {{M|Acid Shells}} will quickly disintegrate, making use of this mod somewhat undesirable when farming resources with {{WF|Nekros|Nekros'}} {{A|Desecrate}}.

==Tips==
*Due to the Blast damage from this mod scaling with enemy health, directly killing heavy units will result in nearby enemies taking higher damage and possibly dying outright from the resulting explosion, making a room-clearing chain reaction more likely.
*This mod scales tremendously well against the {{Faction|Infested}}, since most of them have no armor to reduce the explosion's damage.
*{{M|Acid Shells}}' explosion will trigger the [[Extra Hit]] from {{WF|Cyte-09}}'s {{A|Resupply}}, {{WF|Garuda}}'s {{A|Seeking Talons}}, {{WF|Grendel}}'s Passive [[Warframe Augment Mods|Augment]] {{M|Gastroparesis}},{{WF|Oraxia}}'s {{A|Silken Stride}}, {{WF|Saryn}}'s {{A|Toxic Lash}}, {{WF|Uriel}}'s [[Uriel/Abilities/Passive|Vythelas]], and {{WF|Xaku}}'s {{A|Xata's Whisper}}.
**Because these effects are considered Sobek's damage, they too can trigger Acid Shells, further improving the chance of large chain reactions.
** {{A|Xata's Whisper}}'s, and {{A|Toxic Lash}}'s damage instance from {{M|Acid Shells}} scales from elemental damage, physical damage, and faction damage, but not from status damage or damage mods.
***Other extra hits do not benefit from elemental or physical damage.
*[[:Category:Faction Damage Mods|Faction damage mods]] and {{WF|Rhino}}'s {{A|Roar}} apply to the mod's explosion damage.
**Abilities that increase damage on enemies, or debuff their damage resistance, such as {{WF|Banshee}}'s {{A|Sonar}}, {{WF|Nova}}'s {{A|Molecular Prime}}, or {{WF|Saryn}}'s {{A|Spores}}, can indirectly enhance it.
*The explosion affects breakable containers, giving an effect similar to {{M|Looter}} as long as there are enemies around to proc the explosion.

==Trivia==
*Prior to {{ver|18.10.6|fix}}, this mod's [[polarity]] was Zenurik.
*This mod, along with the other Executioner mods, is among the second set of mods to feature non-generic enemies on the mod card, the first being {{M|Vengeful Revenant}}.
*At the time of [[Operation: Rathuum]]'s announcement, this mod was referred to as '''Execution Shells''', likely an earlier name for the mod. This initially caused confusion with players trying to look for the nonexistent mod.
*The mod is used by [[Executioners/Nok|Executioner Nok]], although his version can remove armor.

{{Top|Tenno|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss' signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss' hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.}} {{Leverian|The Acceltra, a rapid-fire micro-missile launcher. The smooth polycarbonate barrels still carry a vague stench of ozone. Some think Gauss was a blunt instrument, all speed, with as much versatility as a cannonball. But the Acceltra implies more. It implies surging in, inviting the enemy to consider the blade, then rebounding to let missiles answer their confusion.}} The '''Acceltra''' is {{WF|Gauss}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] automatic micro-missile launcher with high [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[fire rate]], and explosive splash damage. The rockets arm after traveling a set distance to protect the user, and the launcher reloads faster while [[Maneuvers#Sprinting|sprinting]]. When wielded by {{WF|Gauss}}, the sprint reload boost is doubled. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} and {{D|Impact}} damage. *Rockets have a minimum arming distance of '''7''' meters and explode in a '''4''' meter radius after impacting a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. *Rocket direct impacts have a guaranteed {{D|Impact}} proc. *Reloading while [[Maneuvers#Sprinting|sprinting]] gives a '''+25%''' [[reload speed]] bonus ('''+50%''' when used by {{WF|Gauss}}/{{WF|Gauss Prime}}). *Innate {{Pol|Naramon}} polarity. {{Advantages| *Minimum arming distance reduces the potential of [[Stagger|self-stagger]] unless rapidly moving to the rocket's impact before exploding. }} {{Disadvantages| *Projectiles have travel time. *Minimum arming distance reduces the weapon's effectiveness at point blank. *Explosions inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosions have a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 50% from central impact. *Very small ammo capacity; requires just 2 reloads to fully deplete all ammo reserves. }} {{WeaponComparison|Acceltra Prime}} {{Acquisition|Acceltra's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating [[Demolisher|Demolisher Infested]] on the [[Dark Sectors|Dark Sector]] mission [[Ur]], [[Uranus]].}} {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *While sprinting, reload speed is increased by '''25%''', or '''50%''' when used by {{WF|Gauss}}. Without other mods, sprinting reload speed is '''1.75''' seconds, or '''1.5''' seconds with Gauss. *The Acceltra's rockets have a minimum arming distance of '''7''' meters, meaning that they will not explode if they make contact with objects or enemies within that range, and thus making the Acceltra safe to use in close quarters combat. **Arming distance is '''unaffected''' by [[Projectile Speed]]. **Regardless, it's still possible to deal self-stagger if the wielder is moving fast enough (either through [[Maneuvers]] and/or using certain [[Abilities]]) to catch up to the rockets. ==Tips== *{{M|Hunter Munitions}} is recommended as the Acceltra's high critical chance allows it to compensate for the low {{D|Slash}} damage and low Status chance, dealing Bleed procs to groups of enemies. *Using white or other bright colors for the energy color can make it very hard to see where projectiles are striking due to large numbers of explosive and particle effects. Consider using a darker energy color like navy blue or black. The first color affects the effects and second the central explosion. *Although the arming distance is unaffected by [[Projectile Speed]], it is recommended to avoid [[Riven Mods]] that reduce it to avoid getting caught in the blast radius. *Due to its low ammo reserves and faster reload while sprinting, the player should always be on the move to keep the weapon firing at a consistent pace. **Players may also use {{M|Ammo Case}}, {{M|Rifle Ammo Mutation}} ({{M|Primed Rifle Ammo Mutation|Primed}}), or {{M|Vigilante Supplies}} to better manage ammo, with Vigilante Supplies' Set bonus in particular complementing the Acceltra's critical stats. **Players can also use the Helminth ability {{A|Energized Munitions}}, effectively quadrupling their magazine capacity as long as it's active, which can further help to mitigate this weapon's ammo inefficiency. ==Trivia== *The mechanics of both the Acceltra and the {{Weapon|Akarius}} are similar to [[wikipedia:Gyrojet|Gyrojet]] firearms, which were developed in the 1960s and also fired small rockets that armed themselves as they traveled out of the gun. In real life, accuracy and reliability issues meant that the Gyrojets never entered mass production. *The "fins" on the Acceltra's barrel are where the rockets are stored, and hatches on top of them open up while firing or reloading. ==Media== File:U25.7 Acceltra.jpg Screenshot 481.png|Acceltra Screenshot 482.png File:Liger-inuzuka-gauss-rifle-concept-art-for-uplox.jpg|Concept art File:ACC-1.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|OwY_Rc_vqfM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Uub7Mjer8nk|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|6zY3TOlnq7k|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|JDSL35oltCc|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|42}} *Doubled the drop chance of the Akarius Blueprint and Acceltra Blueprint from Demolisher Infested {{ver|37}} *Fixed Terminal Velocity Mod not affecting the Acceltra’s projectiles. {{ver|33.5.2}} *Fixed Acceltra causing self-damage when Primed Firestorm is equipped. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 40 Ammo per Pick Up: *Acceltra ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|30.8.1}} *Fixed excessively bright explosion FX from the Acceltra. {{ver|27.3.8}} *The Acceltra has been given explosion FX tweaks for visual and performance improvement. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Acceltra: 50% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|25.7.6}} *Fixed unintended fire rate increase for Acceltra while jumping. {{ver|25.7.4}} *Fixed Acceltra not having the correct model/text when picking it up. {{ver|25.7.2}} *Acceltra can now equip Rifle Ammo Mutation Mod. {{ver|25.7}} *Introduced. }} ==See also== {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Acceltra]] [[fr:Acceltra]] [[Category:Update 25]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[uk:Аксельтра]]

{{Codex|Styanax's speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.}}
{{Leverian|As Styanax struck and struck again with the Afentis, making little headway against the relentless Leviathan, a final desperate scream from Aria achieved the impossible.

It awoke Darro.

From out of those thousands of fused bodies, a single mind was suddenly saying no.

Latching his remaining arms around his tormentor's throat with the very last of his life's strength, the doomed Darro distracted the Philanthropist long enough for Styanax to act.

One last act of love and protection, for his sister.

But the Warframe hesitated. It seems he understood the importance of Darro's rebellion.

If one mind could turn upon its master... why not all of them?

With but a gesture, he gave the captive minds their freedom.

'''Afentis''' is a speargun that serves as the [[Signature Weapon]] of {{WF|Styanax}}. It shoots ballistic projectiles that embed itself on a surface or enemy before exploding, dealing high {{D|Blast}} damage but is burdened by low [[fire rate]] and low magazine. When thrown with [[Alternate Fire]] it impales enemies onto surfaces; impacting the ground instead produces a field that boosts ally Weapons' [[reload speed]], [[fire rate]], [[attack speed]], reserve [[ammo]] and reduces [[recoil]]. In Styanax's hands, it gains increased [[Ammo Maximum]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Blast}} damage.
*Primary Fire shoots ballistic projectiles, causing a small '''3''' meter explosion after '''0.8''' seconds on impact with a surface or enemy.
**Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting [[Stagger|self-stagger]], but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the projectile.
**Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}.
*[[Alternate Fire]] throws a ''duplicate'' of the Afentis, allowing the player to keep using the speargun instead of switching to their secondary arm:
**Throwing the spear consumes 1 ammo, then reloads the weapon.
**If it hits an enemy, they are impaled to the surface for '''20''' seconds.
***Shockwave inflicts self-stagger, despite dealing no radial damage.
**If it does not hit an enemy, the spear produces a '''Ballistarii Might''' field in a '''5''' meter radius around the spear.
***The field lasts for '''10''' seconds.
***Killing an enemy while player is within the Ballistari Might field will maintain the buff for '''40''' seconds which counts down upon leaving the field.
***Ballistarii Might grants the following buffs:
****'''+50%''' [[reload speed]]
****'''+20%''' [[fire rate]] and [[attack speed]]
****'''+100%''' [[ammo|reserve ammo]]
****'''-50%''' [[recoil]].
***The buff affects both primary, secondary, melee, and [[Gravimag|atmospheric]] [[Archgun]]s.
***The field does not benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}.)
**Only one spear can be deployed at a time. Throwing the spear again will remove existing spears.
***Thrown spear is unaffected by [[multishot]].
*Reloads '''33%''' of the magazine per second while [[holster]]ed.
*Innate two {{Pol|Madurai}} and one {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities.

{{Advantages|class=Speargun|
*Primary Fire:
**{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s penalty is very minimal on this weapon.
}}
{{Disadvantages|class=Speargun|
*Primary Fire:
**Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
**Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 80% from central impact.
*Low magazine size and ammo pickup.}}
{{WeaponComparison|Afentis Prime}}

==Acquisition==
Afentis's blueprint is available from [[Chipper]] of [[Kahl's Garrison]] for 60 {{Resource|Stock (Kahl)}}, requiring players to be at '''Rank 5 - Home''' to purchase.
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon|name=Afentis}}

==Notes==
*When wielded by {{WF|Styanax}}/{{WF|Styanax Prime}}, Afentis gains '''+4''' [[Ammo Maximum]].
*The Afentis is currently unique in terms of speargun primary fire usage, in which the crossbow component has its own manual reload animation sequence before launching another bolt, unlike other spearguns which are essentially simply point and fire.
*Due to the Afentis having high explosive shots with potentially massive damage and limited ammunition, the speargun is best treated as if it is a launcher-type primary.
**When combining multishot mods with {{M|Heavy Caliber}}, one of the bolts will fly towards the point of aim while the rest of the bolts will fan out slightly and explode extremely close to the point of aim even at long ranges.
*The primary fire's explosion will ragdoll all enemies caught in it, regardless if they are immediately killed by it or not.
*Planting a delayed explosive bolt on a surface before a [[Nullifier Crewman|nullifier bubble]] crosses it causes the resulting explosion to deal damage to anyone within the bubble, but not anyone outside it.
*Equipping [[Punch Through]] mods will cause the Afentis's bolts to knock down all enemies that they pass through.
*While the bolt's delayed explosion does not trigger headshot conditions, the bolt itself does.
**Triggering bonus critical chance from {{M|Argon Scope}} ({{M|Galvanized Scope|Galvanized}}) or {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}} will therefore still reinforce the delayed explosion's critical multiplier.
*Ballistari Might does not apply to companions.
*Excess ammo that is picked up and stored due to the buff is kept and remains usable after the buff ends.

==Tips==
*When fighting from a holdout position in [[Survival]] and [[Defense]] missions, plant the Ballistarii Might field well within squadmates' reach  so that everyone can easily benefit from the added firepower.
**Note that triggering the extended Ballistarii Might buff ''will not automatically grant'' the bonus ammunition reserves, so players must manually pick up the extra ammo while the buff is active or, alternatively, use a [[Squad Ammo Restore]] deployable for quick replenishment.

==Bugs==
* The Arsenal lists Afentis's Radial Attack's Status Chance as 10%, despite it being 24%.
*Afentis is able to equip {{M|Vigilante Supplies}}, but not any other Ammo Mutation mod.
**Vigilante Supplies also does not function properly, picking up and consuming secondary ammo boxes without giving ammunition to the Afentis, essentially reducing the mod to a simple 5% chance to upgrade critical hits and no other bonuses. for this reason, it is best to equip an unranked version of the mod, if you insist on using it.

A built AX-52 was acquired by watching [[TennoCon/2024|TennoCon 2024]] on [https://twitch.tv/warframe WARFRAME's Twitch] with a [https://www.warframe.com/twitch/link Twitch-linked account] for 30 consecutive minutes, between 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. ET, on July 20th, 2024. ==Trivia==
*The AX-52 seems to be inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Kalashnikov rifle|Kalashnikov rifle]], a family of assault rifles that includes the [[Wikipedia:AK-47|AK-47]] and the [[wikipedia:AK-74|AK-74]]. 
**The "AX" portion of the name may be an interpretation of ''[[Wikipedia:AK-74#AKS-74|AKS]]'', a variant of the AK-74 that has a folding stock.
**The "52" is derived from subtracting 47 from 99 (in reference to 1999).
**Notably, despite the name referencing the original 1947 rifle, the lower receiver resembles the stamped design used on later iterations upon the design, most notably the AKM. 
***Whether this is an intentional homage or simply an artistic choice is unclear, as this is a common mistake, especially in the realm of action films and video games from the time being harkened back to.
***Interestingly, this detail is also present on the Counter Strike depiction of the Kalashnikov that the AX-52 borrows the recoil pattern from.
*AX-52 first appeared in [[TennoCon/2023|TennoCon 2023]]'s [[Whispers in the Walls]] gameplay teaser. Upon the quest's formal introduction in {{ver|35.0}}, the weapon is listed as "????". The quest AX-52 also had a magazine size of 30 instead of 40, and an ammo max of 500 instead of 540.
*An AX-52 can be found in one of the rooms of the [[Netracells]].
*The weapon has a non-static model, with a reciprocating charging handle.
*The fire selector is not static. It will change to the "safe" position when holstered.
**Both "AwTOhH" (Auto) and "SEhMAyeH" (Semi) options are marked on the weapon in Höllvanian, though the latter cannot be selected.
*The AX-52 appears to have the same recoil pattern, albeit less pronounced, as the AK-47 from Counter-Strike.
